Kwame, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from 2 November says so: "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's cutover recap from 8 December 2025 gives the same date.

The recap also says Bettina kept running PHL day to day through 21 November to finish the terminal cutover. You took over day-to-day on 22 November. For the CRM's official ownership date, use 3 Nov 2025. If the CRM has a field for when you started actively running the account, use 22 Nov 2025.
